logger.doc:name: Log already posted
logger.message: #[output application/json indent=false --- { event: 'erp.post.skipped', reason: 'ALREADY_POSTED', invoiceId: vars.invoiceId }]

set-payload.doc:name: Already posted response
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, erpStatus: 'ALREADY_POSTED', erpDocumentNumber: vars.invoice.erpDocumentNumber, postedAt: vars.invoice.erpPostedAt }]

set-variable.doc:name: 409 override
set-variable.value: #[{ httpStatus: 409, code: 'INVALID_INVOICE_STATE', message: 'Only APPROVED invoices can be posted; invoice is ' ++ vars.invoice.status }]

logger.doc:name: Log ERP failure
logger.message: #[output application/json indent=false --- { event: 'erp.post.failed', invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, errorType: (error.errorType.namespace default '') ++ ':' ++ (error.errorType.identifier default '') }]

set-variable.doc:name: 502 override
set-variable.value: #[{ httpStatus: 502, code: 'ERP_UNAVAILABLE', message: 'ERP did not accept the posting after retries; the request can be retried later' }]

set-variable.doc:name: 422 override
set-variable.value: #[{ httpStatus: 422, code: 'ERP_REJECTED', message: 'ERP rejected the invoice: ' ++ (vars.erpResult.errorCode default '') ++ ' - ' ++ (vars.erpResult.errorMessage default '') }]

db:update.doc:name: Store ERP document number
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE invoices SET erp_document_number = :documentNumber, erp_posted_at = :postedAt, version = version + 1 WHERE invoice_id = :invoiceId AND erp_document_number IS NULL

db:update.doc:name: Consume PO amount
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE purchase_orders SET invoiced_amount = invoiced_amount + :amount, status = CASE WHEN invoiced_amount >= total_amount THEN 'FULLY_INVOICED' ELSE 'PARTIALLY_INVOICED' END WHERE po_number = :poNumber

db:update.doc:name: Consume PO line quantity
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE purchase_order_lines SET quantity_invoiced = quantity_invoiced + :quantity WHERE po_number = :poNumber AND line_number = :poLine
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ poNumber: vars.invoice.poNumber, poLine: payload.poLineNumber, quantity: payload.quantity }]

db:insert.doc:name: Audit ERP posting
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO processing_audit_logs (invoice_id, correlation_id, step, outcome, message, actor, details) VALUES (:invoiceId, :correlationId, 'ERP_POSTING', 'SUCCESS', :message, 'system', :details)

logger.doc:name: Log posted
logger.message: #[output application/json indent=false --- { event: 'erp.post.succeeded', invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, erpDocumentNumber: vars.erpResult.erpDocumentNumber }]

set-payload.doc:name: Posted response
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { invoiceId: vars.invoiceId, erpStatus: vars.erpResult.erpStatus, erpDocumentNumber: vars.erpResult.erpDocumentNumber, fiscalYear: vars.erpResult.fiscalYear, postedAt: vars.erpResult.postedAt }]
